name: Remotion OffthreadVideo Alpha Import
use_when: A transparent ProRes/WebM overlay needs to be reused inside a Remotion composition.
The agent is stacking pre-rendered text, glow, transition, or lower-third alpha clips.
The imported clip has real alpha that must survive the final render.
avoid_when: The imported footage is opaque background video.
The overlay can be rendered directly as a Remotion component more simply.
Render speed matters and the source does not need alpha.
The source file has not been verified as alpha-capable.

timeline_pattern.performance_rule: Use transparent mode only for alpha-bearing video and trim it to the visible range.
timeline_pattern.debug_rule: If the clip renders black in empty areas, verify source alpha before changing the composition.

motion.rule: The imported overlay should be trimmed and placed on the same frame window as its intended visual event.

keyframe_values.trim: Trim transparent sources to visible frames where possible.
keyframe_values.placement: Place the source with frame-accurate Sequence timing when the overlay is beat or phrase synced.
keyframe_values.inspection: Check start, midpoint, and clear frames after final render, not only preview.

sound.rule: Keep audio muted or separated unless the transparent source intentionally includes audio that belongs to the overlay.

captions.rule: If the imported overlay contains text, check caption collision and duplicate-text suppression in the parent composition.

color.rule: Inspect semi-transparent edges and optional tone mapping over contrasting backgrounds.

implementation.ffmpeg: Use ffprobe or alphaextract to confirm alpha before using the file in Remotion; transcode to a known alpha format if alpha is not preserved.
implementation.remotion: Use <OffthreadVideo transparent src={...} /> for alpha-bearing video; avoid transparent mode for ordinary opaque footage.
implementation.blender: Import alpha videos or image sequences with transparent material settings and verify premultiplication behavior.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Import the transparent overlay above the base footage if the format is supported; otherwise pre-composite externally.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Import alpha video above the base timeline and verify alpha interpretation rather than applying chroma key.

common_mistakes: Forgetting the transparent prop and losing alpha during render.
Using transparent extraction on opaque footage and slowing renders unnecessarily.
Trusting preview without inspecting final rendered frames.
Failing to trim a long transparent source.
Blaming Remotion layout before verifying the source file really contains alpha.
qc: Source alpha is verified before import.
OffthreadVideo uses transparent mode only for alpha-bearing files.
Overlay is trimmed to the needed window.
Rendered output is checked over bright and dark backgrounds.
No unexpected black rectangle appears behind the imported overlay.
